lines.t: It’s the seventh day, let the blessings fly!
Turn it up, light it down, peace all around,
Shabbat Shalom, Shabbat Shalom
Six days grind, now it’s time to unwind,
Put the stress on mute, hit reset on your mind.
No work zone, just faith and home,
Keep it holy, that’s the cornerstone.
The Father sees, the hearts that give,
To the lost and broken so all can live.
Lift the needy, keep that vow,
The Sabbath starts right here and now!
Hey! Shabbat Shalom, we dance, we sing,
Hearts on fire for the Righteous King.
Sunday’s not the day, can you feel that beat?
Saturday, yeah — that’s the seat!
Hands to the sky, joy so deep,
Saturday holy — you shall keep!
It’s the saints, yeah, who stay aligned,
With love and truth so intertwined.
Messiah inside, pure in name,
Word and deed — no shame, all flame!
Rock that faith with the rhythm and grace,
Let the Sabbath shine in every place.
Rest and rise in the holy zone,
That’s the heartbeat of the throne.
Hey! Shabbat Shalom, we dance, we sing,
Hearts on fire for the Righteous King.
Sunday’s not the day, can you feel that beat?
Saturday, yeah — that’s the seat!
Hands to the sky, joy so deep,
Saturday holy — you shall keep!
Stop that hustle, drop that phone,
Enter peace, you’re not alone.
One command — keep it real,
Healing flows when the Sabbath’s sealed!
The fatherless rise, the widow’s fed,
Needy hearts find peace instead.
Work of love, that’s where we stand,
Seventh day strong across the land!
Oh, Shabbat Shalom — let the music roll,
Let that rest ignite your soul.
Sunday’s not the Sabbath, truth won’t sleep,
Saturday holy — you shall keep!
Yeah, Saturday holy — we shall keep!
